outcome_rules.PASS: Required predicate is established by applicable evidence for the exact subject and selected scope.
outcome_rules.FAIL: Applicable evidence establishes a violated required predicate, including a known integrity or authority mismatch.
outcome_rules.NOT_EVALUABLE: Required inputs, applicable standing, execution or review evidence are absent, unavailable, unsupported or stale; missing proof is not proof of violation.
outcome_rules.collect_all: Evaluate independent checks even when another fails. A blocked dependent check records NOT_EVALUABLE and the exact reason.

aggregation_rule: For the exact selected phase: FAIL if any required check FAIL; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE if any required check is NOT_EVALUABLE; otherwise PASS. Do not aggregate all 14 checks into validation or pre-decision eligibility.
eligibility_rule: All checks 01-12 PASS on current exact inputs; check 13 is NOT_EVALUABLE solely because owner admission has not been selected; check 14 is excluded before application. If a Decision already exists, assess its binding and application through the later phases rather than treating it as pending.
profile_standing_rule: Candidate profiles and proposed profile carriers support explicitly bounded preview analysis only. Binding digests establishes integrity; separate applicable determinations establish adopted standing.

checks.purpose: Resolve exact subject type, schema and representation; reject unknown fields and changed digests.
required_inputs: selected admitted Definition/v2 descriptor and schema
checks.pass_when: Exact discriminator, schema identity/digest and closed schema pass; subject identity/version unique.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Require three present voices with explanatory voices explicitly non-normative.
checks.pass_when: All voice fields and notation/boundary/testable declarations satisfy carrier requirements; semantic agreement is assessed separately in DEF2-10.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Resolve each exact source, selector, integrity, standing at capture and permitted target use.
checks.pass_when: Every declared governing source resolves at exact digest with applicable standing and use. Missing applicable source evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE; known inadmissibility/mismatch is FAIL.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Resolve semantic/drift roles and admitted assignments within the exact scope.
checks.pass_when: Role names resolve to admitted assignments, owner scope is established, and no local key is treated as identity or appointment.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Bind exact generator and require canonical JSON to match deterministic human projection.
checks.pass_when: Two renders are byte-identical and match the bound human projection; this does not authenticate origin.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Close declared dependency and relation obligations, endpoint pairs and carrier roles.
checks.pass_when: Every declared connection resolves under current contract, with qualifiers where required. An empty embedded list passes only its bounded reference subcheck; absence of undeclared required coupling is not inferred.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Verify exact proposed registry, unique index entry, generated lookup and accountable drift route.
checks.pass_when: Exactly one selected candidate version is proposed, history preserved, postimages reproducible and drift owner/route current; placeholder strings do not count as resolved material.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Resolve named consumers, compatibility, source/use gaps and all required current affected bindings.
checks.pass_when: All required current bindings have supported compatible/update dispositions; blocking or unsupported deferred obligations remain visible and block readiness.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Inspect scoped non-collapse and internal-consistency evidence with exact interpretation and coverage.
checks.pass_when: Required bounded checks have applicable evidence, assumptions, executed coverage and no unresolved required counterexample. Unsupported temporal/deontic/empirical clauses require explicit owner-qualified disposition; they cannot receive a fabricated global PASS.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Record attributable interpretation/voice/source fidelity review of the exact meaning.
checks.pass_when: Owner review explicitly accepts fidelity to selected meaning and source scope. Author commentary, lexical differences or answering go-next does not satisfy this check.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Resolve applicable profile/carrier standing, exact bindings and foundational compatibility.
checks.pass_when: Required profile mechanics/type/evaluation/lifecycle determinations and foundational compatibility are effective for the intended use. Proposed-only schemas/profiles are usable for preview discussion, not assumed admitted enforcement.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Freeze exact reviewed inputs, requested effects, owner routes and deterministic output recipes.
checks.pass_when: Review material identifies exact candidates, evidence, independent roles, postimages/recipes and invalidation conditions without requiring the future admission Decision or hashing itself.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Verify the separate exact owner decision selecting this admission effect.
checks.pass_when: Applicable owner Decision exists and matches the exact eligible subject, evidence/recipes and selected effect; no Decision is fabricated during preview.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.

checks.purpose: Verify the separate exact admission application and effective lookup visibility.
checks.pass_when: Exact authorized application is confirmed, with coherent selected epoch and replay-safe identity; a Decision alone does not prove the effect occurred.
checks.claim_ceiling: Exact subject and declared use only; grants no new authority.
